runner-a.note: wide; stretches to each shape; score captions tiny

runner-b.note: wide: phone and tablet turned, bars at the sides; says Tap on touch, Space on the laptop

runner-c.note: upright phone: robot and score small, the lower half empty ground

flappy-a.note: first tap on the title ignored; spread thin across the laptop

flappy-b.note: upright; the laptop shows a column with bars

flappy-c.note: upright phone: bee small, a third of the screen ground; the best laptop view

match3-a.note: swipes swap (20 to 17 moves); arrows move a cursor

match3-b.note: starts only from its Play button; swipes swap (20 to 15 moves); laptop column

match3-c.note: board fills each shape (20 to 14 moves by swipes); small HUD captions on the phone

action-a.note: drag to move + a 4-spell bar, the bar also on the laptop

action-b.note: joystick + 4-spell arc, both thumbs at once; starts only from Play; laptop: keys, no touch buttons

action-c.note: joystick + arc on touch, a J K L I spell bar on the laptop

platformer-a.note: small touch buttons; on the laptop they sit over the level

platformer-b.note: arrows + jump / dash / slide, double and wall jump on Jump; the left arrow sits over the cat at the start

platformer-c.note: upright phone: cat small, little of the level ahead

moba-a.note: tap to move + 3 skill buttons (also on the laptop); tiny HUD on the laptop

moba-b.note: joystick + attack / dash / stun / blast arc; starts only from Play

moba-c.note: upright phone: the lane runs sideways in a thin band; the best laptop view
